reports.title: Liquid AI releases LFM2.5 QAD Q4_0 quantized checkpoints, recovering 97% of accuracy loss
reports.description: Liquid AI has released four Q4_0 GGUF checkpoints—LFM2.5-230M, 350M, 1.2B-Instruct, and 2.6B—trained with Quantization-Aware Distillation (QAD). They retain native Q4_0 memory and speed while recovering 97% of the average accuracy loss of BF16.
